pulls.title: schemas: register EvidenceRecord
pulls.body:
## Scope
Changed files:
- schemas/v1/common/evidence-record.json (new)
- schemas/registry.json
- contract-tests/fixtures/evidence-record-valid.json (new)
- contract-tests/fixtures/evidence-record-invalid.json (new)

## What this adds
EvidenceRecord is the full document written by twgt-bridge to `evidence/*.json`. It has three required parts:

- **`decision`** — same shape as `evaluation-record.json`, referenced not duplicated
- **`batch`** — `bridge_version`, `collected_at`, `source`, `entries`
- **`manifest`** — SHA-256 binding between batch and decision, plus `evidence_version` const `1.0.0`

The manifest's `payload_hash` is asserted by pattern (`sha256:<64 hex>`). The semantic binding between `payload_hash` and the batch content is checked at runtime by `validateManifest()` in `lib/evidence.mjs`, not by the schema. Schema asserts shape, runtime asserts the cryptographic relation.

## Verification — EXECUTED
Local run on this head:

    node contract-tests/run-ts.mjs

- exit 0
- 11 schemas, 22 fixtures, 0 failures

Both new fixtures pass. The valid fixture is a full document with a populated manifest and a `payload_hash` matching the required pattern.

## Evidence class
EXECUTED for the local test run named above. RESEARCH_PATTERN for the schema shape, read from `twgt-bridge/lib/collector.mjs` and `lib/evidence.mjs` at commit `6de01f1`.

## Follow-up
After this merges, twgt-bridge will vendor it and add a contract test asserting its actual output validates against the schema.

pulls.title: schemas: register EvaluationRecord and regenerate fixtures
pulls.body:
## Scope
Changed files:
- schemas/v1/common/evaluation-record.json (new)
- schemas/registry.json
- contract-tests/fixtures/evaluation-record-valid.json (new)
- contract-tests/fixtures/evaluation-record-invalid.json (new)
- contract-tests/fixtures/agent-request-valid.json
- contract-tests/fixtures/agent-request-invalid.json
- contract-tests/fixtures/tool-invocation-valid.json
- contract-tests/fixtures/tool-invocation-invalid.json

## What this adds
EvaluationRecord is the shape returned by twgt-bridge `evaluate()`. Required fields: `state`, `checks`, `reason`. `state` is `EVIDENCE_READY` or `HELD`. Each check entry is `VALIDATED` or `HELD` with a `reason` from the canonical enum registered in `evidence-reason-code.json` (PR #9).

The name deliberately avoids the word "Admission". The bridge does not admit; it produces evidence. Human admission belongs to the consuming repository.

## Fixture regeneration
Four `agent-request` and `tool-invocation` fixtures also changed. The fixture generator now materializes local `$ref` dependencies — those fixtures previously carried `"sample"` as a placeholder for `trace_context`, and the regenerated fixtures carry the referenced object. This is a correctness fix, not a behavior change.

## Verification — EXECUTED
Local run on this head:

    node contract-tests/run-ts.mjs

- exit 0
- 10 schemas, 20 fixtures, 0 failures

The two new fixtures (`evaluation-record-{valid,invalid}.json`) were generated from the schema and pass under the mini validator.

## Evidence class
EXECUTED for the local test run named above. RESEARCH_PATTERN for the schema shape, read from `twgt-bridge/lib/admission.mjs` at commit `5469918`.

## Follow-up
After this merges, twgt-bridge will vendor `evaluation-record.json` and add a contract test that asserts the shape it produces matches the schema. Same pattern as the ReasonCode contract that landed in PR #12.

## Follow-up
After this merges, twgt-bridge will vendor the enum and add a contract test that asserts the two lists are identical. Drift between the repos fails CI.

pulls.title: feat(m3): differential comparison engine with fail-closed divergence …
pulls.body:
Implements M3 (SG-03). Replaces the `differential` stub in ci.yml with a real job that runs 12 tests.

## What landed

- contract-tests/differential/normalize.mjs — deterministic normalization. 11 documented transient keys are stripped; unknown keys are never transient.
- contract-tests/differential/run.mjs — recursive diff by JSON pointer. Reports TYPE, MISSING, EXTRA, LENGTH, VALUE divergences with exact paths.
- contract-tests/differential/run.test.mjs — 12 tests, all failure paths produce HELD.
- 5 fixtures — identical (modulo transient), value-diverged, missing-key, extra-key.

## Test result

12/12 pass locally. Node 26, `node --test contract-tests/differential/run.test.mjs`.

## Fail-closed

- Unknown keys never stripped — an extra key is a divergence, not a silence
- Missing files exit 3 with `[HELD] FILE_MISSING`
- No args exits 2 with usage
- `decide()` never returns ADMITTED when any divergence exists

Evidence class: Implementation evidence.

- registry-integrity: green
- schema-fixtures: green
- differential, safety-gate, privacy, supply-chain, reproducibility: red — stubs by design, land in M3–M7
